Spellshape @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Reach Spell]

Firmware Enhancement You become trained in martial tech weapons. Whenever you increase your proficiency with simple weapons, you also increase your proficiency with martial tech weapons. When you reach 5th level, you gain access to the critical specialization effects of simple and martial tech weapons.

Overclock Boost (tech weapon) When you make a Strike with an overclocked weapon, you ignore the penalty for making attack rolls within your second range increment, and you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your targets have due to cover by 2, or by 4 if you're 12th level or higher.

Overclock Pulse—Overclock Weapon 1 (flourish) Requirements You're wielding an overclocked weapon Effect Make a Strike with your overclocked weapon. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll and a status bonus to damage equal to half your level rounded up.

Basic Jailbreak (3rd)—Amplify Signal When you use Jailbreak Spell to apply @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Reach Spell] to a spell that deals damage, you gain an item bonus to damage equal to the base weapon die of your overclocked weapon (such as 1d6 for an overclocked laser pistol). This bonus damage applies only to one of the spell's targets of your choice and is of the same damage type the spell normally deals.

Advanced Jailbreak (8th)—Signal Boost When you use Jailbreak Spell to apply Reach Spell to a spell, you increase the spell's range by 60 feet, rather than 30 feet.
